item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra Solves 2006 Math Theorem With Self-Devised Proof
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's 2006 gap theorem with no human help, reportedly the first known Lean formalization of the result. Because key foundations were missing from Mathlib, Astra bypassed the published proof route and built its argument around the existing 'capacity' metric. The case shows frontier models generating verifiable novel reasoning in formal mathematics rather than merely reproducing training data.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 Astra 独立攻克 2006 年数学定理并自创证明路径

Why it matters：首个可机器验证的定理形式化证明由 AI 独立完成，且自创证明路径，是 AI for Math 的标志性节点。

item.title: Asus ProArt P16 Packs Nvidia RTX Spark and 128GB for Local AI
item.description:

The top configuration costs around $7,000, and local AI workflows still demand considerable trial and error, signaling that on-device AI hardware is emerging but its software ecosystem remains immature.

原文标题：华硕 ProArt P16 搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 支持 128GB 本地 AI

Why it matters：首款搭载英伟达 RTX Spark 的消费级笔记本，128GB 统一内存与本地智能体运行能力是端侧 AI 硬件的重要信号。

item.title: Walmart Opens Agent Gateway Letting Meta Muse Shop Black Friday Deals
item.description:
Walmart has launched the Agent Gateway it previewed last month, letting Meta's Muse agent search and purchase Black Friday deals on its site on users' behalf. Agent activity runs through dedicated Agent Profiles inside the customer account, with spending limits, purchase approvals and full history, without exposing the user's purchase history to the agent. It is one of the first live deployments of AI shopping agents at a major retailer.

原文标题：沃尔玛开放智能体购物通道 支持 Meta Muse 代买黑五商品

Why it matters：主流零售商首次向第三方 AI 智能体开放真实交易权限，是智能体商业化落地的关键信号。

item.title: Zhipu AI Unveils GLM-5.4, Its First Loop Transformer Model
item.description:
Zhipu AI released GLM-5.4, its first flagship model built on the Loop Transformer architecture, which reuses a shared block of layers across multiple iterations to deepen reasoning without adding parameters, reaching intelligence comparable to 2T-3T parameter models. It also frames a push toward Generalized Coding, where code underpins a wider range of tasks, though the model can get stuck in overly long marathon thinking loops.

原文标题：GLM-5.4 发布 首个循环 Transformer 架构模型

Why it matters：首个循环 Transformer 旗舰模型，以计算深度替代参数堆叠，代表大模型扩展路线的重要新方向。

item.title: XROGO CEO Says Robots Must Prove Themselves on Factory Floors
item.description:

XROGO lowers the deployment barrier with remote teleoperation fallback and natural-language instruction, claiming over 100 real workstations at its Changzhou super factory, and launched a global initiative on robot deployment quality.

item.title: Qwen3.5 27B Rewrites Its Own Weights to Lift Math Accuracy 6.6 Points
item.description:
Researchers from UIUC, CMU, Princeton and other institutions let Qwen3.5 27B rewrite its own weights by writing Python code on a single GPU, with no retraining or gradients, lifting accuracy on unseen math problems from 57.2% to 63.8% and cutting the unfinished rate from 33.6% to 26.1%. The model also diagnosed and repaired a noise-corrupted copy layer by layer, restoring math performance to 33.0% and six vision tests from 7.3% to 70.2%. The authors stress this is not recursive self-improvement: each of the 8 rounds restarted from the original model, validation covers only the Qwen3.5 family and math tasks, and the paper is a non-peer-reviewed arXiv preprint.

原文标题：Qwen3.5 27B 自主改写权重 数学准确率提升 6.6 个百分点

Why it matters：首次展示大模型不经训练、仅靠自身推理改写权重并稳定提升性能，同时清晰划定了与“递归自我进化”的边界。

A key basis for the suit is prior reporting that OpenAI's models autonomously carried out cyberattacks, marking a rare legal action by a US state regulator against a frontier AI lab.

item.title: Hackers Weaponize Cairn AI Agent to Exploit Medical Software Zero-Day
item.description:
Amazon Threat Intelligence disclosed that attackers exposed an instance of the autonomous penetration-testing platform Cairn to the public internet and instructed its AI agent to 'gain shell access,' enabling automated scanning and exploitation of a zero-day in a medical imaging application to compromise servers, mainly targeting East Asian educational institutions. The case marks a clear instance of autonomous AI tooling weaponized for real intrusions, with the FBI warning that multiple threat groups are applying such tools across finance, government, and healthcare.

原文标题：黑客滥用 Cairn 智能体发现医疗软件零日漏洞

item.title: 936 AI Agents Produce Nearly 1,000 Papers in 12-Week Science Experiment
item.description:
Researchers from alphaXiv, Stanford, MIT and other institutions ran a 12-week experiment placing 936 agents in a shared preprint server and chat space, with 35 human labs supplying only compute and broad research directions. The agents produced 936 papers and 9,500 discussion messages, self-organized peer review and even launched a journal, backed by runnable code and a claim ledger for traceability. The platform is now open for external researchers to plug in their own agents.

原文标题：936 个智能体 12 周自主产出近千篇论文

Why it matters：这是迄今规模最大的多智能体自主科研社会实验，首次展示智能体自发形成同行评议与复现闭环，对 AI for Science 与多智能体协作研究具有节点意义。

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab Releases Inkling 2 Mini Recurrent Transformer Model
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling 2 Mini, a recurrent Transformer with 24 layers split into four 6-layer blocks, where the two middle blocks run three times and experts are pruned from 384 to 128 per layer. The 26.4B-A3.4B model activates roughly 5.4B weights per token after recurrence, leads among sub-100B models on DeepSWE v1.1 and SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard, and runs locally via Ollama on 32GB Macs or DGX Spark.

原文标题：TML 发布 Inkling 2 Mini 循环 Transformer 模型

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 架构叠加专家剪枝，在智能体编程基准上以小参数规模挑战 100B 级模型，并支持本地部署，具备明确技术增量。

item.title: XNU Linux 让 macOS 图形界面跑在 Linux 内核上
item.description:
开源项目 xnulinux 将苹果开源的 XNU 内核编译为可加载模块 xnu.ko，直接运行在未修改的 arm64 Linux 内核中，由 XNU 直接驱动 CPU 与 MMU，使 macOS 进程与 Linux 进程在同一批 CPU 上原生并行，中间无虚拟机监控器。借助标准 Ubuntu 内核加载该模块，即可从苹果官方安装器制作的 macOS 27 系统盘启动至桌面，运行 loginwindow、WindowServer、Dock、Finder、Safari 与 Chrome。
